properties.name: Eagle Heights Community Center
properties.description: The University Apartments community center is a centralized location that features Eagle's Wing childcare and education programs, a gymnasium, kitchen, two meeting/classroom spaces, a study room, and main offices for University Apartments staff.

properties.name: Kronshage Residence Hall
properties.description: Kronshage Residence Hall , home to over 600 undergraduate students, is divided up into eight smaller buildings, or “houses,” of about 75 residents each. It consists of Jones House, Chamerblin House, Conover House, Gilman House, Mack House, Showerman House, Swenson House, and Turner House. This residence hall, part of the Division of University Housing, is located right along the Lakeshore Path, near the Porter Boathouse and two dining marketplaces.

properties.name: Bakke Recreation & Wellbeing Center
properties.description: The Bakke (bah-kee) Center features spaces dedicated to supporting wellbeing services (such as the Wolf Teaching kitchen, restorative studios, and rooms for massage therapy, peer wellness coaching, and meditation), as well as a 25-yard recreational pool, eight multipurpose courts, Sub-Zero Ice Center, a climbing and bouldering wall, sports simulators, multipurpose studios, an indoor jogging track, a rooftop fitness area, and over 29,000 square feet of fitness space.

Carillon Tower
properties.description: The Carillon Tower is 85 feet high and houses 56 bronze bells. This carillon is one of three in Wisconsin. Visitors may climb the tower during the free concerts, held on Sundays at 3 p.m. during the academic year.

Labs will be located in the Medical Sciences Center .

properties.description: Rheta’s Market is a large dining marketplace equipped with eight different stations. Rheta’s offers customers a wide variety of meals and snacks. The dining area includes an assortment of seating options for secluded study breaks and tables to share with floor mates.
